settings.title: Social Login Settings
settings.description: Manage the signup, linking and retention policies of social login.

email_conflict_policy.label: Existing Member With Same Email
email_conflict_policy.hint: What to do when the social account email matches an existing member email.

options.verify_link: Link after confirming the existing account (recommended)
options.auto_link_verified: Link at once when the provider verified the email (caution: trusts the provider check as is)

extra_info_mode.label: Signup Extra Info Screen
extra_info_mode.hint: When to show the extra info screen on social signup.

options.when_missing: Only when required info is missing

webhook_unlink_policy.label: Provider Unlink Notice
webhook_unlink_policy.hint: What to do when the provider reports that the member removed the app connection.

two_factor_enabled.label: Two-Factor For Social Login
two_factor_enabled.hint: When off, even members with an authenticator app skip two-factor on social login.

allow_admin_social_login.label: Allow Administrators
allow_admin_social_login.hint: Allow members with an administrator role to sign in with a social account.

allow_unlink_last_method.label: Allow Unlinking Last Method
allow_unlink_last_method.hint: Allow a member without a password to remove their last social link. They can then only return through password reset.

revoke_on_unlink.label: Revoke Provider Access On Unlink
revoke_on_unlink.hint: Also revoke the app authorization at the provider when a member or administrator removes a link.

state_ttl_minutes.label: Sign-In Round Trip Lifetime (Minutes)
state_ttl_minutes.hint: The member must return from the provider within this time. 3 to 30.

pending_signup_ttl_minutes.label: Pending Signup Lifetime (Minutes)
pending_signup_ttl_minutes.hint: Time to finish the signup screen after the provider check. 5 to 120.

custom_provider_limit.label: Custom Provider Limit
custom_provider_limit.hint: Number of OIDC providers an administrator can add. 0 to 10.

profile_raw_retention_days.label: Raw Profile Retention (Days)
profile_raw_retention_days.hint: How long to keep the raw provider profile for troubleshooting. 0 keeps nothing. 0 to 90.

attempt_log_retention_days.label: Attempt Log Retention (Days)
attempt_log_retention_days.hint: How long to keep attempt records used by stats and diagnostics. 7 to 365.

webhook_event_retention_days.label: Webhook Log Retention (Days)
webhook_event_retention_days.hint: How long to keep provider notice records. 7 to 365.

signup_surge_threshold_per_hour.label: Signup Surge Threshold (Per Hour)
signup_surge_threshold_per_hour.hint: Notify administrators when this many members sign up through one provider within an hour. 0 disables the notice.

provider_failure_streak_threshold.label: Provider Failure Streak Threshold
provider_failure_streak_threshold.hint: Notify administrators once a day when one provider fails this many times within 10 minutes, even with successes in between. 0 disables the notice.

warnings.auto_link_verified: Risk: links an existing account with the same email at once, trusting only the provider's verified flag. If someone signed up with that email first or the provider's check is wrong, the account can be taken over.
warnings.two_factor_off: Caution: when off, even members with an authenticator app (TOTP) are not asked for a code on social sign-in.

fields.label: Display name
fields.signup_allowed: Allow new signups with this provider

hints.enabled: When on, the button appears on the sign-in and signup screens. Credentials are required to turn it on.
hints.secret: A stored value shows as ••••••••. Leave it to keep it; clear it and save to delete it.
hints.admin_key: Used to verify unlink webhooks and to revoke member links.
hints.scopes: Separate with spaces or commas. Leave empty for the driver defaults.
hints.signup_allowed: When off, only linked members can sign in with this provider; new signups are refused.
hints.webhook_app_id: Enter the app ID (digits) from the Kakao developer console to ignore unlink notices sent for other apps. Leave empty to skip the check.
hints.webhook_ip_allowlist_enabled: Accept webhooks only from Kakao sender ranges. Behind a reverse proxy, configure trusted proxies first.
hints.placeholder_warning: Members who sign up with a placeholder email (…@social.invalid) cannot receive mail — no mail two-factor, notices or password reset mail; they confirm themselves by signing in again with the provider.
hints.email_trust: Kakao, Google and generic OIDC default to "Trust the verified flag only"; Naver and Facebook, which send no email verified flag, default to "Always trust". "Always trust" treats even unverified provider emails as confirmed.
hints.key: 2 to 50 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. Built-in provider names and keys starting with mock_ are reserved.

email_missing.deny: Refuse sign-in (ask to consent again at the provider)

email_trust.flag: Trust the provider's verified flag only

providers.impact_body: Turning off {{provider}} or changing its credentials affects these members.
providers.impact_social_only: Members who sign in only with this provider
providers.impact_warning: Members who sign in only with this provider lose every way to sign in when it is turned off. Ask them to set a password via password reset.

kakao.client_secret_default_on: Kakao turns Client Secret on by default. Issue the code under [App] > [Platform Keys] > [REST API Key] > [Client Secret] in the console and enter it (KOE010 otherwise). The Redirect URI is registered on the same REST API Key screen.
kakao.biz_app_email: Receiving emails requires switching to a business app and setting the email consent item.
kakao.reconsent_needs_email_item: If the app has no email consent item and "When no email is given" is set to "Refuse sign-in", the [Share your email again] button on the sign-in screen ends in a Kakao error (KOE205). Choose "Ask for it" for such apps.
kakao.redirect_koe006: KOE006 occurs when the Redirect URI differs from the registered value.
kakao.webhook_https_443: Kakao accepts only https on port 443 for the unlink webhook URL. If the site runs on another port, provide a separate address served on 443.

naver.review_no_test_account: Until the review is approved, only test IDs registered in the console can sign in. Naver rejects the review if sign-up asks for a separate site password (this plugin never asks).
naver.redirect_exact: Register the service URL and callback URL exactly as the address above.

google.redirect_exact_match: Authorized redirect URIs must match character for character (including a trailing /).
google.unverified_app: Before the app is published, only accounts added as test users can sign in.

facebook.strict_mode: Add the address above to Valid OAuth Redirect URIs and keep Strict Mode on.
facebook.email_app_review: The email permission may need App Review (advanced access).
facebook.data_deletion_callback: Put the data deletion callback address above into the app's "Data Deletion Callback URL".

oidc.redirect_exact: Register the Redirect URI above at the IdP exactly as shown.
oidc.discovery_https: The discovery URL and every endpoint must be https.
